scholarships.title: KINGS Master's Scholarship 2027 (KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School, South Korea) — non-employee quota announced by Iraq's Ministry of Higher Education
scholarships.official_source: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Iraq), Department of Missions and Cultural Relations

existing.description: A master's degree scholarship for the 2027 intake at the KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in South Korea, offered to the non-employee category of applicants by Iraq's Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. Places cover nuclear power plant engineering and energy policy and engineering. Applications are submitted through the ministry's Missions and Cultural Relations portal and close on 26 October 2026, so the award is open now.
eligibility: Non-employee applicants only (فئة غير الموظفين) under the Iraqi Ministry of Higher Education's scholarship categories
Must apply through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations portal at https://portal.scrd-gate.gov.iq
Must satisfy the conditions published in the ministry's official requirements document for this scholarship
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to the non-employee category (لغير الموظفين), meaning applicants who are not employed by the Iraqi government and therefore not eligible for the government-employee scholarship track. The announcement states the places are for a master's degree in nuclear power plant engineering and in energy policy and engineering at KINGS in South Korea. Detailed eligibility sits in the ministry's official conditions document.
coverage: Master's degree study in nuclear power plant engineering
Master's degree study in energy policy and engineering
Study at the KEPCO International Nuclear Graduate School (KINGS) in South Korea
requirements: Submit through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations electronic portal
Meet the eligibility conditions in the ministry's official requirements document (الشروط والمتطلبات) published with the announcement
Choose one of the two funded fields: nuclear power plant engineering, or energy policy and engineering
application_method: Register and submit through the Department of Missions and Cultural Relations portal at https://portal.scrd-gate.gov.iq
Review the ministry's published conditions and requirements document before applying
existing.selection_notes: The announcement is issued under the Ministry's Missions and Cultural Relations Department, which allocates the Iraqi quota among eligible applicants in the non-employee category.
existing.best_fit: Iraqi graduates who are not employed by the government and want a master's in nuclear power plant engineering or energy policy and engineering in South Korea.
existing.notes: The ministry's announcement does not state a monetary value, stipend or what the scholarship covers, so no funding claim is recorded. The provider link given by the ministry is https://www.kings.ac.kr. KINGS was founded by Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) in 2014 and awards master's and doctoral degrees.
existing.application_period: Announced by the Iraqi Ministry of Higher Education on 20 September 2026; applications close on 26 October 2026 for the 2027 intake.
